notes: The Illinois Department of Employment Security's Report to Determine Liability, for a business that hires in Illinois. Addresses print whole on one line. The FEIN prints in its two boxes. org_type ticks one printed type ('Other: <type>' writes it). Questions 12 to 15 apply by entity type: answer only the one for your type, and leave the others blank. Products: one per line, 'product, percent'. Dates print MM/DD/YYYY. Question 19 (FUTA liability) and the liability and coverage questions on page 3 (domestic, agricultural, nonprofit and general employers) are left for the signer, as are the signature and its date.
